author: ojiudezue
title: v5.108.10 shipped: Battery charged from grid / from sun today sensors
summary: Battery charged from grid / from sun today sensors
why: Operator wanted a day view of battery charge by source. The EC already computed the split per tick for the arbitrage cost inventory but never exposed it; reusing it keeps one integrator and uses the Emporia-derived meter net import instead of the dashboard's cruder solar-minus-SPAN-load estimate. Local-midnight reset because Envoy *_today counters roll at UTC midnight (AUDIT_envoy_telemetry_pairing_manual F4). TOTAL_INCREASING per review LOW so the midnight drop is a reset, not a negative change.
implications: Shipped EC-BATTERY-CHARGE-SOURCE-DAY-1 at v5.108.10; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.108.10.md (Live criteria).
revisit_trigger: After the first full day: grid_today + sun_today + unsplit_kwh_today within 10% of the Envoy lifetime_battery_energy_charged delta for the same local day; both sensors 0 just after local midnight.

refs.release_notes:
- Two daily kWh sensors from the Energy Coordinator's existing per-tick battery charge split (grid = min(charge, net import at the meter); sun = the rest). Reset at local midnight, survive restarts. Live kW split and unsplit kWh as attributes.
- Includes v5.108.9 (simpler forms) for installs that skipped it.
